scope: Fresh static review of EXT-F-4121-T01 through EXT-F-4124-T01. No browser, login, backend, or runtime execution; no canonical inventory or status edit.

EXT-F-4122-T01.evidence: The revised steps observe the takeover card and closure in Chat and omit post-reply inspection of the unmounted Tools runner. The text response envelope remains explicitly unverified.

EXT-F-4123-T01.evidence: The revised steps capture the selected conversation's plan title/status and task count/titles before the run, compare that same panel after rejection and reload, and restrict the card check to appearance and closure. update_plan guards savePlan, setPlanStatus, and addTasks on a non-null conversation ID, while Tools supplies null.

EXT-F-4124-T01.evidence: The proposal retains NOT_EXECUTABLE. Tools supplies conversationId=null and user_todos returns No active conversation before any action. Future steps require a real agent-dispatched conversation fixture, which is not supplied here. None of its seven controls is claimed as executed.

overall: The three manual card procedures have source-supported visible observations and negative validation checks. The fourth is an honest non-executable case pending a real agent fixture. These verdicts approve procedure quality only, not runtime behavior or inventory closure.
